verdict.rationale: A hardware security-key vendor could plausibly publish versioned SDKs or protocol APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document API versioning or any deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The docs cover only WebAuthn/FIDO compatibility, management tools and setup guides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
